g.text: Passing a base64-encoded script hides the command from casual review and from naive command-line matching; it is
common in loaders and rare in hand-written admin work.
PowerShell fetching remote content in one command is a common first-stage loader pattern; admin scripts rarely
A process started below an Office application made an outbound connection; documents that launch helpers which then
reach the network are a common phishing delivery pattern.
